questions.prompt: Which of these films are set in space?
questions.fact: Christopher Nolan directed Interstellar, Inception, Tenet and Dunkirk. Only one of them leaves Earth.

questions.prompt: Which of these cocktails are made with gin?
questions.fact: A Negroni is equal parts gin, Campari and sweet vermouth, stirred over ice.

questions.prompt: In what year was the film Titanic released?
questions.fact: December 1997. It became the first film to take more than a billion dollars at the box office.

questions.prompt: How long is a Formula 1 Grand Prix, in kilometres?
questions.fact: The fewest laps that take a car past 305 km. Monaco is the exception, at about 260 km.

questions.prompt: Which vitamin does sunlight help your body make?
questions.hint: It helps you build strong bones.
questions.fact: Your skin makes vitamin D when sunlight hits it, which is why people in cloudy countries often run short in winter.

questions.prompt: Who was the first emperor of Rome?
questions.hint: He was Julius Caesar's adopted son.
questions.fact: Julius Caesar was never emperor. Augustus took the title in 27 BC, after Caesar had been murdered.
